root.label: James Patrick Lyons Minnesota threats case dismissal

events.label: James Patrick Lyons Minnesota threats case dismissal

slots.name: charges dismissed
slots.sentence: Federal prosecutors quietly dismissed charges this week against a California man who was set to go on trial on Monday for sending hostile text messages to federal agents during the immigration crackdown in Minnesota.

slots.name: prison exposure
slots.sentence: Mr. Lyons’s lawyer, Peter Wold, said the government had offered his client a misdemeanor plea deal that would have spared him from serving time in prison — an offer he declined.

slots.name: messages sent
slots.sentence: Mr. Lyons was accused of sending five messages to some of those numbers in which he said that he hoped the agents would “burn in hell.”

slots.name: threat counts
slots.sentence: The dismissal of the charges against Mr. Lyons , who faced five counts of making interstate threats to injure law enforcement officers, adds to the scores of federal cases that have unraveled in the Trump administration’s efforts to ramp up deportations.
